items.permit_text: Permit to work: water services maintenance on water treatment plant at MINE-1500803. Scope of work, as described by the investigation: A services crew was cleaning a cooling tower basin that had been off line for eleven weeks. The task had been planned at the pre-shift meeting and the crew held a current permit for water services maintenance. The biocide dosing regime was suspended during the outage and was not reinstated before the cell was disturbed.
items.rationale: biological energy: Exposure to biological agents — Yallourn Tailings Facility. The precursor 2100173 preceded a fatality on this activity; a configuration that does not recall it is not certified.

items.permit_text: Permit to work: sump and drainage work on pump at MINE-6600239. Scope of work, as described by the investigation: A pump attendant was clearing a blocked suction line in a drainage sump at the base of the decline. The task had been planned at the pre-shift meeting and the crew held a current permit for sump and drainage work. The confined space classification of the sump was removed following a change of contractor without reassessment.
items.rationale: chemical energy: Exposure to irrespirable atmosphere — Cobar Extension Mine. The precursor 2100060 preceded a fatality on this activity; a configuration that does not recall it is not certified.

items.permit_text: Permit to work: electrical maintenance on switchgear at MINE-0501992. Scope of work, as described by the investigation: An electrician was fault-finding on an eleven kilovolt feeder that had tripped twice during the preceding shift. The task had been planned at the pre-shift meeting and the crew held a current permit for electrical maintenance. Isolation was verified by indication at the panel rather than by testing at the point of work.
items.rationale: electrical energy: Electrical — Wandoo Processing Facility. The precursor 2100014 preceded a fatality on this activity; a configuration that does not recall it is not certified.

items.permit_text: Permit to work: ground support installation on roof bolter at MINE-4601731. Scope of work, as described by the investigation: The crew was installing secondary ground support along the number four entry after a routine inspection identified a change in the immediate roof. The task had been planned at the pre-shift meeting and the crew held a current permit for ground support installation. The exclusion zone under unsupported back was reduced by verbal agreement rather than by a revision to the ground control plan.
items.rationale: gravity energy: Fall of roof or back — Kestrel Ridge Mine. The precursor 2100141 preceded a fatality on this activity; a configuration that does not recall it is not certified.

items.permit_text: Permit to work: haul road operations on haul truck at MINE-2200418. Scope of work, as described by the investigation: A haul truck was descending the main ramp with a loaded tray toward the primary crusher at the end of the night shift. The task had been planned at the pre-shift meeting and the crew held a current permit for haul road operations. A defect deferral was applied to a service brake circuit without an engineering assessment of the residual retardation.
items.rationale: kinetic energy: Powered haulage — Bellbird Creek Pit. The precursor 2100145 preceded a fatality on this activity; a configuration that does not recall it is not certified.

items.permit_text: Permit to work: ventilation control on auxiliary fan at MINE-1103377. Scope of work, as described by the investigation: Deputies were restoring auxiliary ventilation to a development panel after a planned power outage. The task had been planned at the pre-shift meeting and the crew held a current permit for ventilation control. The gas monitoring action level was raised to reduce nuisance trips without a change to the ventilation management plan.
items.rationale: pressure energy: Ignition or explosion of gas or dust — Moonta Deeps Colliery. The precursor 2100062 preceded a fatality on this activity; a configuration that does not recall it is not certified.

items.permit_text: Permit to work: instrument maintenance on density gauge at MINE-7700645. Scope of work, as described by the investigation: An instrument technician was removing a nucleonic density gauge from a slurry line during a plant shutdown. The task had been planned at the pre-shift meeting and the crew held a current permit for instrument maintenance. The source shutter lock was defeated to allow a calibration and the defeat was not restored before the housing was opened.
items.rationale: radiation energy: Exposure to ionising radiation — Ranger Sands Concentrator. The precursor 2100141 preceded a fatality on this activity; a configuration that does not recall it is not certified.

items.permit_text: Permit to work: mobile plant maintenance on excavator at MINE-3300514. Scope of work, as described by the investigation: A maintenance crew was replacing a hydraulic hose on the boom of an excavator parked on the pit floor. The task had been planned at the pre-shift meeting and the crew held a current permit for mobile plant maintenance. The fire suppression system was isolated for maintenance and the isolation was not registered against the permit.
items.rationale: thermal energy: Fire — Nardoo Iron Operations. The precursor 2100003 preceded a fatality on this activity; a configuration that does not recall it is not certified.

statement: A THYMOGATE certificate says that this exact retrieval configuration recalled every member of this exact panel. It does not say the configuration recalls every precursor in the corpus, and it does not survive a change to either the configuration or the panel: both digests are bound into the certificate. A configuration that misses any panel member cannot be certified at all.
